text: Ready-Made Bots now fill in the variables their template declares: values provided by the server, like your music server credentials, arrive pre-filled and locked so a bot always starts configured. Your bot picks a working music server on its own, Ready-Made Bots show up in your home list with readable logs, and the app now tells you when a new version is available. Rewarded ads pay more when you watch several in a day, up to 4 hours per ad. The app is much lighter on the network: live status, a single snapshot instead of many requests, and polling that slows down when you are away. Your hosting end date is now the real one sent by the server. Fixed: subscriptions no longer erased locally when the server answers late, container quota not always blocking a launch, phantom bots created by Ready-Made Bots, and rewarded ads that were not always counted.
